\begin{lexlean}{Studio.User}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.bool@1.2.0}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.nat@1.2.0}
\importmodule{Studio.Runtime}
\importmodule{Studio.Gui.Coordination}
\importmodule{Studio.Gui.Generation}
\importmodule{Studio.Gui.Approval}
\importmodule{Studio.Gui.Instance}
\importmodule{Studio.Gui.Mirror}
\title{Natural number addition}
\begin{semanticmodule}
definition{
  name: joinTabs,
  parameters: [fields : (List Bytes)],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (match fields
    | List.nil => 0x
    | List.cons field rest => (match rest
      | List.nil => field
      | List.cons next more => (prim append field (prim append 0x09 (joinTabs rest) : Bytes) : Bytes))),
  recursive_argument: fields
}

definition{
  name: journeyAnswer,
  parameters: [journey : Bytes, rest : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (if (Studio.Runtime::same journey 0x636f6f7264696e6174696f6e) then (Studio.Gui.Coordination::request rest) else (if (Studio.Runtime::same journey 0x63726561746f72) then (Studio.Gui.Generation::request rest) else (if (Studio.Runtime::same journey 0x617070726f76616c) then (Studio.Gui.Approval::request rest) else (if (Studio.Runtime::same journey 0x696e7374616e636573) then (Studio.Gui.Instance::request rest) else (if (Studio.Runtime::same journey 0x6d6972726f72) then (Studio.Gui.Mirror::request rest) else 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374))))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: view,
  parameters: [kind : Bytes, journey : Bytes, rest : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (journeyAnswer journey rest)
}

definition{
  name: begins,
  parameters: [line : Bytes, pattern : Bytes],
  result: Bool,
  body: (((prim length pattern : Nat) <=? (prim length line : Nat)) && (Studio.Runtime::sameFrom line pattern 0 (prim length pattern : Nat))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: anyBegins,
  parameters: [lines : (List Bytes), pattern : Bytes],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match lines
    | List.nil => false
    | List.cons line rest => ((begins line pattern) || (anyBegins rest pattern))),
  recursive_argument: lines,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: enabledFor,
  parameters: [kind : Bytes, journey : Bytes, action : Bytes, rest : Bytes],
  result: Bool,
  body: (anyBegins (Studio.Runtime::split (view kind journey rest) 10) (prim append (prim append 0x616374696f6e20 action : Bytes) 0x3a20656e61626c6564 : Bytes)),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: human,
  parameters: [kind : Bytes],
  result: Bool,
  body: (Studio.Runtime::same kind 0x68756d616e),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: known,
  parameters: [kind : Bytes],
  result: Bool,
  body: ((human kind) || (Studio.Runtime::same kind 0x6167656e74)),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: channel,
  parameters: [kind : Bytes, journey : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (if (human kind) then 0x7468652053747564696f205549 else (prim append 0x746865204d4350207265736f757263652076657264616e742d73747564696f3a2f2f6775692f journey : Bytes)),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: perceive,
  parameters: [kind : Bytes, journey : Bytes, rest : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (prim append (prim append (prim append 0x70657263656976656420627920 kind : Bytes) (prim append 0x207468726f75676820 (channel kind journey) : Bytes) : Bytes) (prim append 0x0a (view kind journey rest) : Bytes) : Bytes),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: enactedRefusal,
  parameters: [action : Bytes, journey : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (prim append (prim append (prim append 0x726566757365643a2074686520616374696f6e20 action : Bytes) (prim append 0x206f662074686520 journey : Bytes) : Bytes) 0x206a6f75726e6579206973206e6f7420656e61626c656420666f72207468697320757365722c20736f206974206973206e6f7420656e6163746564 : Bytes)
}

definition{
  name: enact,
  parameters: [kind : Bytes, journey : Bytes, action : Bytes, rest : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (if (enabledFor kind journey action rest) then (prim append (prim append (prim append (prim append 0x656e616374656420627920 kind : Bytes) (prim append 0x3a2074686520616374696f6e20 action : Bytes) : Bytes) (prim append 0x206f662074686520 journey : Bytes) : Bytes) (if (human kind) then 0x206a6f75726e65792c207468726f756768207468652053747564696f205549 else 0x206a6f75726e65792c20617320616e204d435020746f6f6c732f63616c6c206f766572205374697463682062792053747564696f2e4167656e742e496e746572666163652e5472616e73706f7274) : Bytes) else (enactedRefusal action journey)),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: kindRefusal,
  parameters: [kind : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (prim append (prim append 0x726566757365643a20 kind : Bytes) 0x206973206e6f206b696e64206f662056657264616e7420757365723b206120757365722069732068756d616e206f72206167656e74 : Bytes)
}

definition{
  name: request,
  parameters: [value : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (match (Studio.Runtime::split value 9)
    | List.cons verb f1 => (match f1
      | List.cons kind f2 => (match f2
        | List.cons journey f3 => (if (not (known kind)) then (kindRefusal kind) else (if (Studio.Runtime::same verb 0x7065726365697665) then (perceive kind journey (joinTabs f3)) else (if (Studio.Runtime::same verb 0x656e616374) then (match f3
          | List.cons action f4 => (enact kind journey action (joinTabs f4))
          | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374) else 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374)))
        | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374)
      | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374)
    | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

theorem{
  name: an_agent_perceives_the_view_a_human_perceives,
  parameters: [journey : Bytes, rest : Bytes],
  statement: ((view 0x6167656e74 journey rest) = (view 0x68756d616e journey rest)),
  proof: reflexivity{},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

theorem{
  name: an_agent_is_held_to_the_guards_a_human_is_held_to,
  parameters: [journey : Bytes, action : Bytes, rest : Bytes],
  statement: ((enabledFor 0x6167656e74 journey action rest) = (enabledFor 0x68756d616e journey action rest)),
  proof: reflexivity{},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

theorem{
  name: an_agent_perceives_its_journey_through_an_mcp_resource,
  parameters: [],
  statement: ((request ) = ),
  proof: decide{},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

theorem{
  name: an_agent_enacts_an_enabled_action_over_stitch,
  parameters: [],
  statement: ((request 0x656e616374096167656e7409636f6f7264696e6174696f6e0973656e64097669657709707269736d3a616c657809707269736d3a6167656e74096472616674656409707269736d3a6167656e743d707269736d3a616c6578) = 0x656e6163746564206279206167656e743a2074686520616374696f6e2073656e64206f662074686520636f6f7264696e6174696f6e206a6f75726e65792c20617320616e204d435020746f6f6c732f63616c6c206f766572205374697463682062792053747564696f2e4167656e742e496e746572666163652e5472616e73706f7274),
  proof: decide{},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

theorem{
  name: refuses_an_agent_an_action_its_guard_disables,
  parameters: [],
  statement: ((request ) = 0x726566757365643a2074686520616374696f6e206772616e74206f662074686520617070726f76616c206a6f75726e6579206973206e6f7420656e61626c656420666f72207468697320757365722c20736f206974206973206e6f7420656e6163746564),
  proof: decide{},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

theorem{
  name: a_person_enacts_an_enabled_action_through_the_studio_ui,
  parameters: [],
  statement: ((request ) = 0x656e61637465642062792068756d616e3a2074686520616374696f6e206772616e74206f662074686520617070726f76616c206a6f75726e65792c207468726f756768207468652053747564696f205549),
  proof: decide{},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

theorem{
  name: refuses_a_user_of_no_known_kind,
  parameters: [],
  statement: ((request ) = 0x726566757365643a20726f626f74206973206e6f206b696e64206f662056657264616e7420757365723b206120757365722069732068756d616e206f72206167656e74),
  proof: decide{},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}
\end{semanticmodule}
\end{lexlean}
